verdict.rationale: Stripe provides explicit sandbox environments isolated from live/production data, with docs describing test-value simulated transactions, team-isolated sandboxes, and even a CLI command (`stripe sandbox create`) specifically aimed at coding agents to provision an anonymous sandbox with working API keys and no account registration required. This directly matches the AI-native testing story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the AI-agent sandbox workflow specifically (evidence is entirely first-party docs).
